content: They fit me well and I like the style, but I find them a little bit too long.
What if you roll them up a little?
I guess I could, but then they would look different.
I see, we can make them shorter for you if you want.
Sure thing, though it will take about 2 hours. You can pay for them first and come back in the afternoon or evening to pick them up.
That's fine. Can I pick them up tomorrow?
